'import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

plt.rcParams.update(
    {
        "font.family": "sans-serif",
        "font.size": 10,
        "axes.edgecolor": "#E6E9EF",
        "axes.labelcolor": "#31333F",
        "axes.spines.top": False,
        "axes.spines.right": False,
        "axes.grid": True,
        "axes.axisbelow": True,
        "grid.color": "#E6E9EF",
        "xtick.color": "#31333F",
        "ytick.color": "#31333F",
    }
)

df = (
    dataset.assign(Datum=lambda d: pd.to_datetime(d["Datum"]))
    .sort_values("Datum")
    .groupby("Jahr", as_index=False)["Index"]
    .last()
    .assign(Rendite=lambda d: d["Index"].pct_change() * 100)
    .dropna()
)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.5))
ax.bar(
    df["Jahr"],
    df["Rendite"],
    color=df["Rendite"].ge(0).map({True: "#0068C9", False: "#FF2B2B"}),
)
ax.axhline(0, color="#31333F", linewidth=0.8)
ax.set_title("Jahresrendite in % (Python)", loc="left", fontweight="bold", color="#31333F")
ax.grid(axis="x", visible=False)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
'
